title: Naga City Hospital gets P25.1M in medical equipment from PCSO

blocks.text: NAGA CITY, Camarines Sur — Patients at Naga City General Hospital will get faster and more accessible diagnostic services after the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over P25.1 million worth of medical equipment to the facility on Thursday. The donation included a digital stationary X-ray machine, an ultrasound machine, and a 2D echocardiogram machine. PCSO chief of staff Jeremy Regino said the equipment would give patients from Naga City and nearby communities better access to diagnostic services without having to travel to other hospitals and diagnostic centers.
